serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Your real name is Amei?
Amei: Yes, sorry for deceiving you.
You: It’s not a big deal; I just wanted to be sure I followed the story.
Amei: That time I spent with the real Melissa was good and simple for me. I just had to follow the orders of a young girl. Play with her, hang out, but everything comes to an end…
Amei: The helicopter she and her father were flying on crashed. She was the only survivor. {{wi}}Although later she wished she wasn’t.
Amei: Her injuries were grave, but thanks to the accumulated wealth of her father, the first 100 or so surgeries were performed with no problem. Unfortunately, at some point even the millionaire's money started running out…
Amei: She was forced to move out of the hospital back to her home. Her situation was grim. She was barely able to pay for the bills and her medications. She was living in constant pain, and with no income, she was bound to go bankrupt.
Amei: That’s when she came up with the idea of me working instead of her. With all the medical paperwork, it was easy to acquire an ID with my face instead of hers. No one dared to suspect a thing since her story was so gruesome. The clerks couldn’t even look into my eyes.
Amei: Everything was working fine for a while, but…{{wi}} Melissa changed…
